captions.caption: A man uses a machete to cut through dense jungle foliage.
He continues hacking away at the thick green vegetation.
The man hacks at a low branch with his machete.
He bends down to clear more plants near the ground.
He stops to look at the area he has cleared.
The man stands still among the tall trees of the jungle.
He surveys the surrounding environment while holding his machete.
The man crouches down on the forest floor and begins poking the dirt with a stick.
He uses the stick to dig a small hole or clear debris from the soil.
He continues to work on the patch of dirt with the stick.
The man is focused on preparing the ground for a trap.
He uses his hands and the stick to manipulate the soil.
He smooths out the dirt in a specific area.
The man continues to dig and clear the forest floor.
He uses the stick to level the ground.
He finishes preparing the soil and prepares the next step.
A close-up shows the man's hands placing small sticks in a cross pattern on the dirt.
He carefully arranges the sticks to form the base of a trap.
The man adds more small branches to the structure on the ground.
He is meticulously building a trigger mechanism with the sticks.
He adjusts the position of a small stick in the dirt.
The man continues to refine the stick arrangement on the forest floor.
He pushes a stick firmly into the ground to secure it.
The man stands up and looks towards a large vine hanging from a tree.
He reaches up and grabs the thick vine with both hands.
The man pulls down hard on the vine to test its strength.
He continues to pull the vine, using his body weight.
He grabs the vine higher up and pulls it down further.
The man hangs from the vine to see if it will hold his weight.
He swings slightly while hanging from the sturdy vine.
He continues to pull the vine towards the ground.
He uses his weight to pull the vine closer to the ground.
The man keeps pulling on the vine, standing in the middle of the jungle.
He holds the vine steady as it hangs down from the canopy.
The man reaches up and begins to tie something to the vine.
He is seen working with a piece of string or wire near the vine.
He continues to reach up and manipulate the vine and string.
The man is focused on attaching a component to the hanging vine.
He pulls on the string to check the connection.
He continues to reach upwards, working on the upper part of the trap.
The man is seen tying a knot to secure the vine.
He works carefully with his hands on the trap mechanism.
He adjusts the tension of the vine and string.
The man continues to reach up and work on the vine.
He pulls on a secondary string attached to the vine.
He is meticulously setting the snare part of the trap.
The man checks the stability of the hanging components.
He finishes the upper part of the trap setup.
The man crouches down again to connect the vine to the ground trigger.
He works on the base of the trap hidden among the leaves.
The man's hands are seen adjusting the trigger mechanism on the ground.
He is mostly obscured by the foliage as he works on the trap.
He continues to refine the connection between the vine and the sticks.
The man is focused on setting the trap perfectly.
He carefully places a few more leaves over the ground trigger.
He finishes the setup and prepares to leave.
The man stands up and looks at his handiwork.
He turns and begins to walk through the dense jungle.
The man moves past a large tree trunk.
He walks further into the forest, disappearing into the greenery.
